text.title: Refusal Field Strict Schema Worked Example
text.summary: Canonical happy-path spec emitted from the smoke-test input, then the refusal-first Pydantic schema in code.

example.note: Smoke-test driver values flow through the decision tree to the default leaf (r1-top-level-refusal). The emitted JSON satisfies the schema in 02-output-contract.xml.
Bad — empty decision and audit; validator fails fast.

example.title: Refusal-first, nullable payload, single typed branch
example.note: Single typed branch handles refusal; payload fields stay null-safe.

example.title: Required payload, no refusal channel
example.code:
class MedicalExtract(BaseModel): diagnoses: list[str] # required, no refusal channel medications: list[str]
# model invents [] or violates grammar → exception
example.note: Model has no legal way to refuse; you get fake empty lists or parser errors.
